title: Stallioneer inventory and editing polish
content:
Stallioneer moved another step from prototype toward a real daily cataloging tool.

What changed:

  • Inventory filtering: the inventory page now uses a compact Filter popup with grouped sort, collection, and tag toggles, including live counts and in-place list updates.
  • Edit-copy flow: multiple physical copies now share one edit surface, selected from an Editing copy dropdown instead of stacking separate full panels down the page.
  • Form styling: Edit Book and Add From Code now use the same compact square-edged control language as Perihelion, including buttons, copy controls, inputs, repeated cards, candidate results, and tag helpers.
  • Live deployment: builds, publishes, network copies, and hash checks were completed throughout the pass so the server runtime stayed aligned with the working source.
